subsection.name: Introduction
subsection.p: This module extends plugin-announce and plugin-subscribe to allow front-office users to subscribe to announcements. Users can subscribe to:

ul.li: A specific user (receive notifications when that user publishes an announce)
A category (receive notifications for all announces in the category)
A search filter (receive notifications for announces matching custom criteria)

subsection.p: A daemon periodically checks for new announcements and sends email notifications to subscribers whose subscriptions match the published content.

subsection.name: Configuration
subsection.p: The module requires the following plugins to be installed and active:
Configure the following properties in announce_subscribe.properties:

ul.li: announce.subscription.notification.maxAnnouncesPerEmail - Maximum number of announces per notification email. Notifications are grouped by subscriber: each user receives a single email containing all matching announces. When the number exceeds this limit, announces are split into multiple emails. Accepted values: 1 to 20 (default: 10).

subsection.p: Important: The following Lutece core properties must be properly configured for email notifications to work:

ul.li: lutece.prod.url - Mandatory. The production base URL of the portal (e.g. https://myportal.example.com). If this property is not set, all links in notification emails will be broken.
mail.server - SMTP server address for sending emails
mail.noreply.email - No-reply sender email address used for notification emails

subsection.name: Usage
subsection.p: The module provides an XPage application accessible at ?page=announce-subscribe with the following actions:

ul.li: doCreateSubscriptionFilter - Subscribe to a search filter

subsection.p: Users can manage their subscriptions via the subscription management page provided by plugin-subscribe.
